text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure it came from over here...

Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Buuut there's no one here... So who was
calling my
name?

text_block_list.text:
Could it have been the Three
Goddesses?

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. My promotional efforts must
have paid
off if even the Three
Goddesses noticed me.
